inputs.name: input_collection
inputs.label: Dataset collection
inputs.help: A list or list:paired collection whose element identifiers will be extracted.

help.content:
===========
Description
===========

Extracts the element identifiers (names) from a list collection and writes them to a plain text file, one per line, in collection order.

This is useful when you need a list of sample names for downstream tools, or to generate label files for relabeling or filtering operations.

Accepts both simple ``list`` and ``list:paired`` collections. For ``list:paired``, only the top-level pair names are extracted (not ``forward``/``reverse``).

.. image:: $PATH_TO_IMAGES/extract_identifiers.png
  :alt: Extract element identifiers from a collection into a text file
  :width: 580

========
Examples
========

**Simple list**

A collection with three elements::

 Collection:
   sample_A  →  dataset1.fastq
   sample_B  →  dataset2.fastq
   sample_C  →  dataset3.fastq

Output::

 sample_A
 sample_B
 sample_C

-------

**List of pairs**

A ``list:paired`` collection::

 Collection:
   pair1/
     forward  →  reads_R1.fastq
     reverse  →  reads_R2.fastq
   pair2/
     forward  →  reads_R1.fastq
     reverse  →  reads_R2.fastq

Output::

 pair1
 pair2
